title: todo.yaml deprecation
body: todo.yaml is deprecated as TODO source of truth. When dump and todo.yaml both exist, dump wins and a diagnostic names both. Cleanup archives to .mcpServer/archive/todo-yaml/ with evidence. Never silent delete.
